description: Calculate statutory South African DLTC triple-hurdle computerized learner's test pass probability across Rules of the Road (min 22/28 or 78.6%), Road Traffic Signs (min 23/28 or 82.1%), and Vehicle Controls (min 6/8 or 75.0%).

controls_score.description: Vehicle Controls score out of 8 questions (statutory pass mark is 6/8)

rules_score.description: Rules of the Road score out of 28 questions (statutory pass mark is 22/28)

signs_score.description: Road Traffic Signs score out of 28 questions (statutory pass mark is 23/28)

vehicle_code.description: Vehicle licence code: 'code_1' (Motorcycle), 'code_2' (Light Motor Vehicle), or 'code_3' (Heavy Motor Vehicle)

name: check_readiness
